description: The main avenue of ancient Dion is a wide street of stone slabs between low walls, column drums, and a few standing shafts, with grass and trees in the park and the massif of Mount Olympus in the distance. Midday is clear, about 20.7°C, and dry. The model cell reports no snowfall. The Sanctuary of Isis, with its water channels, is a different part of the site and is not the subject.
